== Biography ==
Thomas Glasgow was baptised on 8 June 1800 at Kirknewton and East Calder according to the held FamilySearch abstract. His exact birth date is not established by that citation; he was born by the baptism day.<ref>[https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VQ4K-TVX FamilySearch, Scotland Births and Baptisms, 1564–1950], Thomas Glasgow, christening 8 June 1800, Kirknewton and East Calder, father Thomas Glasgow and mother Margaret Chapman; previously held citation, original register uninspected.</ref> The selected father [[Glasgow-1620|Thomas Glasgow]] remains assessed at 98%; the [[Chapman-28491|Margaret Chapman]] maternal identity is not newly graded.
